# Project instructions

- This project uses the stable MCP TypeScript SDK v2 and Node.js 22.12 or later.
- Keep graph analysis deterministic and independent from MCP transport code.
- Add focused Vitest coverage for every scheduling or validation rule.
- Treat stdout as the MCP protocol channel; write diagnostics only to stderr.
- SDK documentation: https://ts.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/v2/
- MCP specification: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/latest
